## Load data
### FLIP
```{r}
FLIP_Clinical <- read_csv(here("Data/FLIP1_ClinicalData.csv"))

FLIP_MicrobiomeParams <- read_csv(here("Data/Microbiome_Parameters_FLIP_VMET2.csv"))

FLIP_Data <- merge(FLIP_Clinical, FLIP_MicrobiomeParams, by='Sequencing Name')

FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Type` == "Participant sample")

FLIP_Data <- FLIP_Data %>%  mutate(Outcome = case_when(Outcome == "Term" ~ "Term",
                                                    Outcome == "iPTB" ~ "iPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "sPTB" ~ "sPTB",
                                                    Outcome == "SPTB" ~ "sPTB",))

# Omit edge cases of pregnancy with rescue cerclage samping and T6A and T3.5
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E29')
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E186')
```

### Define a custom plotting theme to use in figure panel subplots
```{r}
theme_custom_plot <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),  
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
}
```

# Set of Immune Analytes to use
```{r}
ImmuneParams <- c("IL6 (DS 1.7)","IL1B (DS 0.4)", "IL8 (DS x10)", "C1q (AS 0.0335)", "C3a (AS 17.5)", 
                  "C3b (AS 2.3875)", "C4 (AS 0.073)", "Factor H (AS)",
                  "C2 (AS 0.17)", "C4b (AS 0.165)", "C5 (AS 0.4)", "C5a (AS 0.00175)", "Factor D (AS 0.0135)", 
                  "MBL (AS 0.0165)", "MMP-2 (AS 54)", "MMP-8 (AS 17.1)", "MMP-9 (AS)")

# Measurement unit for each analyte y-axis label.
analyte_unit <- function(clean_name) {
  ng_ml <- c("C1q", "C2", "C3", "C3b", "C4", "C4b", "C5",
             "FH", "FD", "FI", "Factor H", "Factor D", "Factor I", "MBL")
  if (clean_name %in% ng_ml) "ng/mL" else "pg/mL"
}

# y-axis label: log10(<display name> <unit>), with tidy names for IL-1beta / IL-6 / C3b.
analyte_ylab <- function(clean_name, unit) {
  # phantom(0) adds a gap that survives in SVG (a ~ space after the symbol beta is dropped there)
  if (clean_name == "IL1B") return(bquote(log[10]~"(IL-1"*beta*phantom(0)*.(unit)*")"))
  disp <- switch(clean_name, "IL6" = "IL-6", "C3b" = "C3b/iC3b", clean_name)
  bquote(log[10]~"("*.(disp)~.(unit)*")")
}

# Paired significance bracket for the VMET/FLIP plots: returns a stat layer only when the
# paired wilcoxon comparison is significant, else NULL (so non-significant bars are omitted
# entirely, not merely stripped of their "ns" label).
paired_signif_layer <- function(data, analyte_name, tp) {
  d2 <- subset(data, Timepoint %in% tp)
  d2$paired_val <- log10(as.numeric(d2[[analyte_name]]))
  sig <- tryCatch(
    ggpubr::compare_means(paired_val ~ Timepoint, data = d2,
                          method = "wilcox.test", paired = TRUE)$p.signif[1],
    error = function(e) "ns")
  if (!is.na(sig) && sig != "ns") {
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(tp), method = "wilcox.test",
                       paired = TRUE, label = "p.signif", size = 3.5)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}
```

# Data analysis
## Immune variation accross time on Colonisers and non-colonisers
```{r}
responder_colour <- c("Responder" = "#619CFF", "Non-responder" = "coral")

create_immune_boxplot <- function(analyte_name, data) {
  
  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", analyte_name)
  unit <- analyte_unit(clean_name)
  if (clean_name == "C3b") clean_name <- "C3b/iC3b"
  
  data_with_log <- data %>%
    mutate(log_analyte = log10(.data[[analyte_name]]))
  
  stat_test_analyte <- data_with_log %>%
    group_by(Responder) %>%
    wilcox_test(log_analyte ~ Timepoint, ref.group = "T0") %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%  
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Timepoint")
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(.data[[analyte_name]]))) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, 
      aes(fill = Responder), 
      alpha = 0.6, 
      show.legend = FALSE, 
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black") + 
    geom_point(aes(fill = Responder), 
      size = 2.5, 
      alpha = 0.8,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.2),
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.3) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = responder_colour,
      labels = c("Responder" = "Coloniser", "Non-responder" = "Non-coloniser"),
      name = "LACTIN-V colonization") +   
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test_analyte,
      label = "p.adj.signif", 
      tip.length = 0.01,
      hide.ns = T,
      size = 3.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Responder, labeller = labeller(
      Responder = c("Responder" = "Coloniser", "Non-responder" = "Non-coloniser"))) +
    labs(y = analyte_ylab(clean_name, unit)) +
    theme_custom_plot()
  
  return(p)
}

# Run on all analytes and save figures. 
all_boxplots <- map(ImmuneParams, ~create_immune_boxplot(.x, FLIP_Immune))
names(all_boxplots) <- ImmuneParams

# Save all plots
walk2(all_boxplots, ImmuneParams, function(plot, name) {
  clean_filename <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)", "", name) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    tolower()
  
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/Immune/Immune_Boxplots_ColvsNonCol/Immune_', clean_filename, '_boxplot.png')), 
    plot, 
    width = 183, 
    height = 100, 
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 300)})
```


## Immune variation accross time, CST transition pregnancies vs CST stable
```{r}
# Colors
cst_t0_colors <- c("CST I" = "#228b22", "Other" = "darkorange3")

# Nature journal theme
theme_nature <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )
}

# Prepare data
FLIP_StartingCST <- FLIP_Immune %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`) %>%
  filter(any(Timepoint == "T0")) %>%
  arrange(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    CST_at_T0 = first(CST[Timepoint == "T0"]),
    CST_I_at_T0 = ifelse(CST_at_T0 == "I", "CST I", "Other")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Function to create CST at T0 boxplots
create_cst_t0_boxplot <- function(analyte_name, data) {
  
  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", analyte_name)
  unit <- analyte_unit(clean_name)
  if (clean_name == "C3b") clean_name <- "C3b/iC3b"
  
  data_with_log <- data %>%
    mutate(log_analyte = log10(.data[[analyte_name]]))
  
  stat_test_analyte <- data_with_log %>%
    group_by(CST_I_at_T0) %>%
    wilcox_test(log_analyte ~ Timepoint, ref.group = "T0") %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%  
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "Timepoint")
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(.data[[analyte_name]]))) + 
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA, 
      aes(fill = CST_I_at_T0), 
      alpha = 0.6, 
      show.legend = FALSE, 
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black"
    ) + 
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = CST), 
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.8,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.2),
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.3
    ) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(cst_colors, cst_t0_colors), 
      breaks = names(cst_colors), 
      name = "CST"
    ) +  
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat_test_analyte,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      hide.ns = TRUE,
      size = 3.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~CST_I_at_T0) +
    labs(y = analyte_ylab(clean_name, unit)) +
    theme_nature()
  
  return(p)
}

# Create all boxplots
all_cst_t0_boxplots <- map(ImmuneParams, ~create_cst_t0_boxplot(.x, FLIP_StartingCST))
names(all_cst_t0_boxplots) <- ImmuneParams

# Save all plots
walk2(all_cst_t0_boxplots, ImmuneParams, function(plot, name) {
  clean_filename <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", name) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    tolower()
  
  # Save as PDF (Nature preferred)
  ggsave(
    here(paste0('./Figures/Immune_Boxplots_T0CST/Immune_', clean_filename, '_t0cst_boxplot.pdf')), 
    plot, 
    width = 183, 
    height = 100, 
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf
  )
  
  # Save as PNG
  ggsave(
    here(paste0('./Figures/Immune_Boxplots_T0CST/Immune_', clean_filename, '_t0cst_boxplot.png')), 
    plot, 
    width = 183, 
    height = 100, 
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 300
  )
})

```


## Assembled panel: colonisation (a) + CST-at-T0 (b) for 5 analytes
```{r}
panel_analytes <- c("IL1B (DS 0.4)", "IL6 (DS 1.7)", "C4 (AS 0.073)",
                    "C3a (AS 17.5)", "C3b (AS 2.3875)")   
n_panel <- length(panel_analytes)

# individual plot formatting function
prep_member <- function(p, is_top, is_bottom, drop_legend = FALSE) {
  p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9))
  if (drop_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  if (is_top) p <- p + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
  else        p <- p + theme(strip.text = element_blank())
  if (!is_bottom) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                                 axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
                                 axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
  p
}

# Panel a: colonisation boxplots
col_a_plots <- lapply(seq_len(n_panel), function(i) {
  p <- prep_member(all_boxplots[[panel_analytes[i]]],
                   is_top = i == 1, is_bottom = i == n_panel, drop_legend = TRUE)
  if (i == 1) p <- p + ggtitle("LACTIN-V colonisation") + labs(tag = "a") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "plain"))
  p
})
col_a <- wrap_plots(col_a_plots, ncol = 1)

# Panel b: CST-at-T0 boxplots
col_b_plots <- lapply(seq_len(n_panel), function(i) {
  p <- prep_member(all_cst_t0_boxplots[[panel_analytes[i]]],
                   is_top = i == 1, is_bottom = i == n_panel)
  if (i == 1) p <- p + labs(tag = "b")
  p
})
col_b <- wrap_plots(col_b_plots, ncol = 1, guides = "collect")

# Assemble figure
immune_panel <- wrap_plots(col_a, col_b, guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", family = "sans"))

ggsave(here('./Figures/Immune/Immune_Panel_Colonisation_vs_CST.png'),
  immune_panel, width = 200, height = 350, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
ggsave(here('./Figures/Immune/Immune_Panel_Colonisation_vs_CST.pdf'),
  immune_panel, width = 200, height = 350, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(here('./Figures/Immune/Immune_Panel_Colonisation_vs_CST.svg'),
  immune_panel, width = 200, height = 350, units = "mm",
  device = svglite::svglite, fix_text_size = FALSE)
```

# Comparison between VMET-2 and FLIP-1
```{r}
# Prepare data
FLIP_paired <- FLIP_Immune %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T3")) %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  
  mutate(
    CST_at_T0 = first(CST[Timepoint == "T0"]),
    CST_I_at_T0 = ifelse(CST_at_T0 == "I", "CST I", "Other")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

FLIP_paired$`IL1b (AS)` <- as.numeric(FLIP_paired$`IL1b (AS)`)

FLIP_paired_responders <- FLIP_paired # %>% filter(CST_I_at_T0 == "Other")

study_colors <- c("VMET-2" = "orchid4", "FLIP" = "forestgreen")

vmet_to_flip_mapping <- list(
  "IL-1B (AS 0.4)" = "IL1B (DS 0.4)",
  "C4 (AS)" = "C4 (AS 0.073)",
  "FH (AS)" = "Factor H (AS)",
  "FD (AS 0.0135)" = "Factor D (AS 0.0135)", 
  "IL-6 (AS 0.85)" = "IL6 (AS)",
  "IL-8 (AS)" = "IL8 (AS)",
  "C1q (AS 0.0335)" = "C1q (AS 0.0335)",
  "C3a (AS)" = "C3a (AS 17.5)",
  "C3 (AS 0.11)" = "C3 (AS 0.11)",
  "C3b (AS 2.3875)" = "C3b (AS 2.3875)",
  "C2 (AS)" = "C2 (AS 0.17)",
  "C4b (AS 0.165)" = "C4b (AS 0.165)",
  "C5 (AS 0.4)" = "C5 (AS 0.4)",
  "C5a (AS 0.00175)" = "C5a (AS 0.00175)",
  "MBL (AS 0.0165)" = "MBL (AS 0.0165)",
  "FI (AS 0.09)" = "Factor I (AS 0.09)",
  "MMP-2 (AS 54)" = "MMP-2 (AS 54)",
  "MMP-8 (AS 17.1)" = "MMP-8 (AS 17.1)",
  "MMP-9 (AS)" = "MMP-9 (AS)"
)

# Function to create VMET paired plot
create_vmet_paired_plot <- function(analyte_name, data) {
  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", analyte_name)
  unit <- analyte_unit(clean_name)
  if (clean_name == "C3b") clean_name <- "C3b/iC3b"
  
  # Replace FH, FD, FI, and IL-1B with proper names
  if (clean_name == "FH") {
    clean_name <- "Factor H"
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"(Factor H ng/mL)")
  } else if (clean_name == "FD") {
    clean_name <- "Factor D"
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"(Factor D ng/mL)")
  } else if (clean_name == "FI") {
    clean_name <- "Factor I"
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"(Factor I ng/mL)")
  } else if (clean_name == "IL-1B") {
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"(IL-1"*beta~.(unit)*")")
  } else {
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"("*.(clean_name)~.(unit)*")")
  }
  
  ggplot(
    subset(data, Timepoint %in% c("A", "B")),
    aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(as.numeric(.data[[analyte_name]])))
  ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = `V2 Number`),
      colour = study_colors[["VMET-2"]],
      alpha = 0.4,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = "VMET-2"),
      size = 2.5,
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Invisible reference layer carrying both studies so the shared legend shows both keys
    geom_point(
      data = data.frame(
        Timepoint = subset(data, Timepoint %in% c("A", "B"))$Timepoint[1],
        yy = median(log10(as.numeric(data[[analyte_name]])), na.rm = TRUE),
        Study = c("VMET-2", "FLIP")
      ),
      aes(x = Timepoint, y = yy, fill = Study),
      shape = 21, size = 2.5, colour = "black", stroke = 0.3,
      alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    paired_signif_layer(data, analyte_name, c("A", "B")) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Study",
      values = study_colors,
      limits = c("VMET-2", "FLIP"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(y = y_label) +
    theme_custom_plot()
}

# Function to create FLIP paired plot
create_flip_paired_plot <- function(analyte_name, data) {
  clean_name <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", analyte_name)
  unit <- analyte_unit(clean_name)
  if (clean_name == "C3b") clean_name <- "C3b/iC3b"
  
  # Check for IL1B (FLIP version) and convert to IL-1β
  if (clean_name == "IL1B") {
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"(IL-1"*beta~.(unit)*")")
  } else {
    y_label <- bquote(log[10]~"("*.(clean_name)~.(unit)*")")
  }
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log10(as.numeric(.data[[analyte_name]])))) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = `FLIP number`),
      colour = study_colors[["FLIP"]],
      alpha = 0.4,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = "FLIP"),
      size = 2.5,
      shape = 21,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    paired_signif_layer(data, analyte_name, c("T0", "T3")) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Study",
      values = study_colors,
      limits = c("VMET-2", "FLIP"),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(y = y_label) +
    theme_custom_plot()
}

# Create all VMET plots
vmet_analytes <- names(vmet_to_flip_mapping)
vmet_paired_plots <- map(vmet_analytes, ~create_vmet_paired_plot(.x, VMET_Immune))
names(vmet_paired_plots) <- vmet_analytes

# Create all FLIP plots
flip_analytes <- unlist(vmet_to_flip_mapping, use.names = FALSE)
flip_paired_plots <- map(flip_analytes, ~create_flip_paired_plot(.x, FLIP_paired_responders))
names(flip_paired_plots) <- flip_analytes

# Save individual combined plots (VMET + FLIP side by side)
walk(vmet_analytes, function(vmet_name) {
  flip_name <- vmet_to_flip_mapping[[vmet_name]]
  
  combined_plot <- vmet_paired_plots[[vmet_name]] + flip_paired_plots[[flip_name]] +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")
  
  clean_filename <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", vmet_name) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("-", "", .) %>%
    tolower()
  
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.pdf')),
    combined_plot,
    width = 183,
    height = 90,
    units = "mm",
    device = cairo_pdf)
  
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.png')),
    combined_plot,
    width = 183,
    height = 90,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 300)
  
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.svg')),
    combined_plot,
    width = 183,
    height = 90,
    units = "mm",
    dpi = 300,
    device = svglite::svglite,
    fix_text_size = FALSE)
})

```

## Assembled VMET-2 vs FLIP paired panel (analytes b–g; 16S panel a added separately)
```{r}
# Panel rows: (b, c) / (d, e) / (f, g); keys are the VMET analyte names
vmet_panel_analytes <- c("IL-1B (AS 0.4)", "IL-6 (AS 0.85)",
                         "C4 (AS)",        "C3a (AS)",
                         "C3b (AS 2.3875)", "FH (AS)")
vmet_panel_tags <- c("b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g")

# One VMET | FLIP pair per analyte, tag on the VMET (left) subplot
vmet_flip_pairs <- lapply(seq_along(vmet_panel_analytes), function(i) {
  vmet_name <- vmet_panel_analytes[i]
  flip_name <- vmet_to_flip_mapping[[vmet_name]]
  (vmet_paired_plots[[vmet_name]] + labs(tag = vmet_panel_tags[i])) +
    flip_paired_plots[[flip_name]]
})

# 6 pairs in a 3 x 2 grid, single collected "Study" legend on the right
vmet_flip_panel <- wrap_plots(vmet_flip_pairs, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", family = "sans"))

ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Paired_Panel.png'),
  vmet_flip_panel, width = 240, height = 260, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Paired_Panel.pdf'),
  vmet_flip_panel, width = 240, height = 260, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Paired_Panel.svg'),
  vmet_flip_panel, width = 240, height = 260, units = "mm",
  device = svglite::svglite, fix_text_size = FALSE)
```

## Full figure: 16S sankey (panel a) imported from Microbiome_Figures.Rmd + paired panel (b–g)
```{r}
# Panel a is the VMET-2 / FLIP CST-transition sankey built in Microbiome_Figures.Rmd and
# saved there as an .rds ggplot/patchwork object — imported natively here so it stays vector.
# (Requires ggalluvial to be loaded to render the geom_flow/geom_stratum layers.)
panel_a <- readRDS(here('Figures/Microbiome_VMETFLIPSankey.rds'))
panel_a[[1]] <- panel_a[[1]] + labs(tag = "a")   # "a" tag on the VMET2 (left) sankey

# Keep the sankey at its native (wide) aspect: place it top-left at ~2/3 width with an
# empty spacer on the right, and give the top row ~1 paired-row of height.
top_row <- wrap_plots(panel_a, plot_spacer(), widths = c(2, 1))
full_immune_figure <- wrap_plots(top_row, vmet_flip_panel, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 2.7)) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", family = "sans"))

ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Full_Figure.png'),
  full_immune_figure, width = 240, height = 350, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Full_Figure.pdf'),
  full_immune_figure, width = 240, height = 350, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(here('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired/VMET_FLIP_Full_Figure.svg'),
  full_immune_figure, width = 240, height = 350, units = "mm",
  device = svglite::svglite, fix_text_size = FALSE)
```

# Paired Plots (non-CST-I subset)
```{r}
# Same polished VMET/FLIP paired plots as the main chunk above (reuses create_vmet_paired_plot /
# create_flip_paired_plot, vmet_to_flip_mapping and study_colors defined there), but the FLIP side
# is restricted to participants that were NOT CST I at T0. Saved to VMET_FLIP_Paired_NonCSTI/.
FLIP_paired <- FLIP_Immune %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T3")) %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  
  mutate( CST_at_T0 = first(CST[Timepoint == "T0"]),
    CST_I_at_T0 = ifelse(CST_at_T0 == "I", "CST I", "Other")) %>%
  ungroup()

FLIP_paired$`IL1b (AS)` <- as.numeric(FLIP_paired$`IL1b (AS)`)

FLIP_paired_responders <- FLIP_paired  %>% 
  # filter(Responder == "Responder")
  filter(CST_I_at_T0 == "Other")

# Create all VMET plots
vmet_analytes <- names(vmet_to_flip_mapping)
vmet_paired_plots <- map(vmet_analytes, ~create_vmet_paired_plot(.x, VMET_Immune))
names(vmet_paired_plots) <- vmet_analytes

# Create all FLIP plots
flip_analytes <- unlist(vmet_to_flip_mapping, use.names = FALSE)
flip_paired_plots <- map(flip_analytes, ~create_flip_paired_plot(.x, FLIP_paired_responders))
names(flip_paired_plots) <- flip_analytes

# Save individual combined plots (VMET + FLIP side by side)
walk(vmet_analytes, function(vmet_name) {
  flip_name <- vmet_to_flip_mapping[[vmet_name]]
  
  combined_plot <- vmet_paired_plots[[vmet_name]] + flip_paired_plots[[flip_name]] +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect")

  clean_filename <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", vmet_name) %>%
    gsub(" ", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("-", "", .) %>%
    tolower()

  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired_NonCSTI/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.pdf')),
    combined_plot, width = 183, height = 90, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired_NonCSTI/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.png')),
    combined_plot, width = 183, height = 90, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
  ggsave(here(paste0('./Figures/VMET_FLIP_Paired_NonCSTI/', clean_filename, '_vmet_vs_flip.svg')),
    combined_plot, width = 183, height = 90, units = "mm",
    device = svglite::svglite, fix_text_size = FALSE)
})
```
